Chapter 282: New Partners Attack The City Together

The direct confrontation between the Zerg army and the alien army ended, and the two armies broke contact and retreated to a safe area to rest.

The ultra-long-range siege equipment in the alien city of 996 has started a new round of maintenance.

The Zerg destroyers were also busy shifting positions and did not continue to attack the alien city of 996.

The position of the main Zerg combat arms moved northward and re-selected a relatively flat area.

When the main Zerg combat arms were redeployed on the new position, two million three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions rushed to the battlefield.

Under the command of the queen, the two million three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions naturally dispersed and continued to merge into the Zerg puppies surrounding the alien city of 996.

Some of them hid directly in the ground, while others mixed with the Zerg puppies and waited for orders.

The movement of more than one million troops to reinforce was of course clearly seen by the observers of various forces in the local camp, and some of them recognized the poisonous ray scorpion.

"This is a very rare poisonous ray scorpion! They belong to a very powerful race. I didn't expect them to get together with the Zerg!"

"This kind of poisonous ray scorpion looks like a Zerg race. It's not strange to be with the same Zerg!"

"I don't know what the relationship is. Looking at the performance of those poisonous ray scorpions, they are no different from other Zerg troops. It feels like they have been completely conquered!"

"This Zerg is mysterious and unpredictable. They can always bring some surprises!"

"The poisonous ray scorpion has powerful long-range attack methods. With these poisonous ray scorpions participating in the battle, the Zerg army should take the initiative to launch an attack!"

"The main combat troops in the Zerg army are still too few. The most numerous melee troops lack effective long-range support, and fighting alone is still flawed!"

"Now with these poisonous ray scorpions participating in the battle, it can effectively make up for the shortcomings of the Zerg melee troops!"

"..."

The purpose of the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion participating in the battle is too obvious. Everyone can guess Wu Qing's thoughts.

The relationship between the Zerg and the poisonous ray scorpion clan in this world is also the focus of everyone's concern.

…

Wu Qing saw through the Zerg host that the space transmission channel in the Tianwai people's Jiujiuliu City has not been activated yet.

This shows that the Zerg army has not put enough pressure on the Tianwai people, making the Tianwai people feel that the current military strength in Jiujiuliu City is sufficient to deal with the Zerg army's attack.

Only half of the Tianwai people's powerful mages have been left, and they have not withdrawn. They are just standing there, waiting for the Zerg queen to kill them one by one.

"Maybe these mages are also bait?"

Wu Qing suddenly thought of this possibility and kept a watchful eye.

"Since no one is leaving, come slowly, don't rush!"

Five hundred five-star Zerg queens have restored their ability to lay eggs and attack. This time they did not attack directly, but waited for the next batch of five hundred five-star Zerg queens to restore their ability to lay eggs and attack.

In this way, Wu Qing will always have five hundred five-star Zerg queens in his hands, and can launch a fatal attack at any time to deal with various possible changes.

Among the tens of thousands of powerful mages of the alien race who cannot be distinguished between true and false, there should not be many real five-star mages. This can be seen from the results of the spawning attack of the three-star Zerg Queen. There are not many alien mages who can resist the spawning attack of the three-star Zerg Queen.

The alien race used a large number of four-star and even three-star mages to deceive the five-star Zerg Queen's fatal attack. This is indeed a very clever move.

To achieve this goal, the alien race dispatched a mysterious chariot, and also lost some five-star mages.

Wu Qing did not want to go into the gains and losses.

As long as Wu Qing's main goal can be achieved, some losses of the Zerg are actually insignificant.

Even if the alien race destroys all the Zerg troops participating in the war, the Zerg can instantly create another such army.

Wu Qing pays attention to some details, just to reduce the casualties of the Zerg, save resources, and develop the Zerg at the fastest speed.

If Wu Qing is more Buddhist and leaves everything to the Queen of the Zerg, he can win even if he lies down.

Because of this confidence, Wu Qing was not nervous at all when the Zerg faced the super alien race alone.

Wu Qing responded to all the means used by the alien race. After being tempered by the super alien race, the Zerg will be more adept at facing enemies of other races in the future.

Unknowingly, the Zerg has developed to this level.

…

150,000 Zerg destroyers, all of whom have the strength of two stars or above, and there are 10,000 five-star Zerg destroyers.

Those Zerg destroyers with the lowest strength and the worst condition have all been upgraded and restored to their best condition.

Those high-star Zerg destroyers originally had stronger recovery capabilities, and after resting and recovering in the relocation position, they are also in good condition.

The combat power of the Zerg destroyers has basically been restored.

“Boom boom boom…!”

The combat power of the Zerg cannot be wasted. The Zerg destroyers launched a super-long-range attack on the 996 cities of the alien race in front of the new position.

In the 996 cities of the alien race, another new urban area suffered a devastating disaster.

The aliens followed the transfer of the main Zerg combat unit and made some adjustments to the defense of Jiujiuliu City.

With the experience of the previous defense, the casualties in Jiujiuliu City were reduced a lot when attacked by Zerg destroyers this time.

After the Zerg Queen killed a group of alien mages again, the Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions in front of the Zerg main combat unit position, with the powerful fire support of 150,000 Zerg destroyers, launched an attack on the alien Jiujiuliu City.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Ten thousand five-star Zerg destroyers concentrated their firepower and completely destroyed the front wall and nearby areas of the Zerg main combat unit.

The firepower of more than 100,000 other star-level Zerg destroyers covered a large area of the city, making the alien army dare not show up at all.

The siege weapons and the assembly areas of various long-range units in the city that were not protected by light energy shields were all attacked.

A large number of Zerg puppies rushed towards Jiujiuliu City. Many Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions were scattered among the Zerg puppies, slowly following behind, trying to avoid the long-range attacks of the alien race.

With the Zerg host watching, as long as there is a long-range attack falling on their area, they will burrow into the ground in advance to avoid it.

5 Qi resources are also Qi, so don't consume them if you can.

Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions provide long-range firepower support for Zerg puppies nearby. Now is not the time for them to take action, so they mainly focus on protecting their own safety.

With the super firepower suppression of the Zerg destroyers, the Zerg puppies successfully rushed to the city wall under the attack of some ultra-long-range siege equipment and powerful mages of the alien race, and climbed over the ruins of the city wall, even if they entered Jiujiuliu City.

In order not to accidentally hurt the attacking Zerg puppies, the firepower of the Zerg destroyers began to spread deep into Jiujiuliu City.

The alien army hidden in the bunkers under the ruins of Jiujiuli City immediately came out to block the Zerg puppies that had already rushed into the city.

The three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that mixed in with the Zerg puppies and occasionally went underground finally showed their abilities on the battlefield.

"Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh...!"

The green light shot out from the tip of the high-raised tail of the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion like a laser, shooting at the alien army soldiers.

The rays with penetrating, burning and highly toxic properties easily penetrated the defense of the alien army soldiers and shot into their bodies.

The name of the highly toxic ray scorpion contains the word "poisonous", so you can imagine how fierce its toxicity is.

Even the alien army soldiers who practiced light attribute energy and had strong resistance to toxicity could not resist the invasion of this highly toxic ray.

Many alien army soldiers who were shot through the vital parts by the highly toxic rays died on the spot and disappeared in light.

Even if the alien soldiers were not hit in the vitals, their combat effectiveness would drop sharply under the attack of the poison, and the Zerg puppies would just have to go and finish them off.

The range of the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion is comparable to that of the Zerg hydralisk, and they can suppress all the alien soldiers that can attack the Zerg puppies remotely.

The three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions came out from the ground one after another, mixed in a large number of Zerg puppies, and gave priority to attacking the remote soldiers of the alien army.

"Swish, swish, swish..."

The green poisonous rays accurately hit the alien soldiers one by one, opening the way for the Zerg puppies to attack.

A large number of Zerg puppies rushed into the city of Jiujiuliu to clean up the alien troops that survived the attack of the Zerg destroyers.

In close combat under complex environments, the Zerg puppies are not afraid of anyone.

Some three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions also rushed into the city and approached to provide fire support for the Zerg puppies.

150,000 Zerg destroyers, under the command of the Queen, used fierce firepower to block the reinforcements of the alien human army.

Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions continued to rush into Jiujiuliu City, gradually clearing out the remaining alien human army.

Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that completed the clearing mission continued to follow the Zerg destroyers' fire line and attack Jiujiuliu City.

Those alien human mages who were guarded by the mysterious chariot used various magic to cover the city area of Jiujiuliu occupied by the Zerg.

Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions were suppressed and entered the underground.

The attack of the Zerg destroyers also has a limit, and they cannot continue to carry out high-intensity attacks.

After a period of fierce attack, their offensive also weakened, and they began to enter a state of rest in turns.

The Zerg army occupied a ruined area of Jiujiuliu City, and the Zerg destroyers, the strongest long-range firepower, entered a stable output stage.

The Zerg army's attack needs some adjustments.
